user.description: This looks for a TellStick USB dongle via a locally running telldusd. There's nothing to fill in -- just confirm you want to set it up.

reconfigure.description: Local mode has no host or port to change -- this only controls how many times each RF command is repeated for reliability.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a local telldusd. Make sure the TellStick is plugged in and a TellStick daemon (e.g. the Telldus add-on) is running.

abort.already_configured: Tellstick is already configured. Only one TellStick is supported per Home Assistant instance.
abort.yaml_net_mode_unsupported: Your existing `tellstick:` YAML config uses Telldus Live (net mode via host/port), which this integration doesn't support -- it's local-only, talking directly to a TellStick over a local telldusd. Remove the `host`/`port` keys from your YAML, or don't import this config.

deprecated_yaml.title: The Tellstick YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Configuring Tellstick via `configuration.yaml` is deprecated and your config has been imported into the UI automatically. Remove the `tellstick:` section from your YAML files.

yaml_net_mode_unsupported.title: Tellstick YAML config uses an unsupported mode
yaml_net_mode_unsupported.description: Your `tellstick:` YAML config sets `host`/`port` (Telldus Live / net mode), which this integration doesn't support -- it only talks to a local telldusd. The YAML was not imported. Remove the `host`/`port` keys, or set up Tellstick fresh from the UI instead.
